de: Battle of Lenzen: Slavic forces (the Redarii and the Obotrites) are defeated by a Saxon army near the fortified stronghold of Lenzen in Brandenburg.

t: 李世民后被后人称为"唐太宗皇帝",为唐朝取而代之.
te: Li Shimin, posthumously known as Emperor Taizong of Tang, assumes the throne over the Tang dynasty of China.
dz: 李世民后被后人称为"唐太宗皇帝",为唐朝取而代之.
de: Li Shimin, posthumously known as Emperor Taizong of Tang, assumes the throne over the Tang dynasty of China.

t: 罗穆卢斯·奥古斯都拉斯被废黜于奥多阿塞尔宣布自己为"意大利国王"后,从而终结了西罗马帝国.
te: Romulus Augustulus is deposed when Odoacer proclaims himself "King of Italy", thus ending the Western Roman Empire.
dz: 罗穆卢斯·奥古斯都拉斯被废黜于奥多阿塞尔宣布自己为"意大利国王"后,从而终结了西罗马帝国.
de: Romulus Augustulus is deposed when Odoacer proclaims himself "King of Italy", thus ending the Western Roman Empire.
